name: interactive-mindmap-editor
description: Create, repair, and extend interactive HTML mind map editors.

interface.shortDescription: Create and fix editable HTML mind maps.
interface.longDescription: Helps Codex convert user text, outlines, articles, and notes into editable standalone HTML mind maps, and repair interaction issues such as two-line editing, collapse hit areas, overlap, wrapping, and recursive node operations.
interface.defaultPrompt: Turn my text into an editable HTML mind map, or help me improve an existing interactive mind map editor.
